mapper.update: UPDATE book_fixed_asset_card SET fixed_asset_subject_id = #{subjectId} where fixed_asset_subject_id = #{fatherSubjectId} and book_id = #{bookId};
UPDATE book_fixed_asset_card SET depreciation_subject_id = #{subjectId} where depreciation_subject_id = #{fatherSubjectId} and book_id = #{bookId};
UPDATE book_fixed_asset_card SET depreciation_fee_subject_id = #{subjectId} where depreciation_fee_subject_id = #{fatherSubjectId} and book_id = #{bookId};
mapper.select: SELECT IFNULL(SUM(month_depreciation),0) from book_fixed_asset_card where book_id = #{bookId} and del_flag = '0' and status = 1 and start_depreciation + month_depreciation <= original_value and year_period <= #{yearPeriod}

SELECT '计提折旧' summary, 'DEBIT' balanceDirection, '借' balanceDirectionText, SUM(month_depreciation) debit, 0 credit, depreciation_fee_subject_id subjectId, depreciation_fee_subject_auxiliary_id auxiliaryId from book_fixed_asset_card where book_id = #{bookId} and del_flag = '0' and status = 1 and start_depreciation + month_depreciation <= original_value and year_period <= #{yearPeriod} GROUP BY depreciation_fee_subject_id,depreciation_fee_subject_auxiliary_id UNION ALL SELECT '计提折旧' summary, 'CREDIT' balanceDirection, '贷' balanceDirectionText, 0 debit, SUM(month_depreciation) credit, depreciation_subject_id subjectId, depreciation_subject_auxiliary_id auxiliaryId from book_fixed_asset_card where book_id = #{bookId} and del_flag = '0' and status = 1 and start_depreciation + month_depreciation <= original_value and year_period <= #{yearPeriod} GROUP BY depreciation_subject_id,depreciation_subject_auxiliary_id
